summary: Essential Utilities filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that on November 2, 2026, it, American Water Works, Alpha Merger Sub and affiliates filed a Stipulation of Settlement in the New Jersey BPU proceeding, joined by NJBPU staff and the New Jersey Division of Rate Counsel; the stipulation was posted November 5, 2026, subject to NJBPU review and approval. The underlying October 26, 2025 merger agreement provides for Merger Sub to merge into Essential, which survives as a wholly owned American Water subsidiary. No price, premium or fees stated. Watch NJBPU approval timing as the key regulatory catalyst; remaining state and federal clearances still required.
